title: Hawaii National Guardsmen Assist with Patrols and Security During Big Island Lava Flow
description: Hawaii Army and Air National Guardsmen were called to support Hawaii County Civil Defense authorities reacting to the Puna lava flow. They patrolled neighborhoods and blocked roads from curious onlookers from the lava flow advancing towards homes.
